title: Accept what the Beloved sends
summary: This meets the moment when the heart starts resisting what has already been given. The line turns complaint into consent before bitterness hardens.
takeaway: Receive the Beloved's doing without inner protest.
lifeApplication: At the doorway or sink, catch the complaint rising in the throat. Say the line once before you narrate the day against yourself.

source.shortMeaning: The heart yields its argument and receives the Beloved's way.
source.lifeApplication: Before the next sigh, unclench the jaw and receive this moment from the Beloved.

evidence.coreClaim: The heart yields its argument and receives the Beloved's way.
evidence.turn: Let the Beloved's way grow dearer than the mind's protest.
evidence.practicalImplication: At the doorway or sink, catch the complaint rising in the throat. Say the line once before you narrate the day against yourself.
